headline: SOMBRAS negative frames launches December 3
title: SOMBRAS Negative Frames | Photography Horror Launches December 3 | Gaming News
video_script: SOMBRAS: negative frames launches on December third, twenty twenty six. It is a first person light horror adventure about photography, from developer Maboroshi Artworks and publisher Entalto Publishing. You play Shiomi, a photography student pulled into a dark version of her hometown who must photograph strange sights to get home. It comes to PlayStation five, Xbox Series, Switch two and PC. Would you take the camera? Comment below!
description: SOMBRAS: negative frames launches December 3, 2026 on PS5, Xbox Series, Switch 2 and PC. Sources: Gematsu, Bloody Disgusting.
joke: At least this ghost hunt only needs a camera and no flashlight battery.
